title: Device login
instruction: Enter the code shown in your terminal.
confirm: Confirm this is the code shown in your terminal.
error: This code is unknown, already used, or expired — run `pmon login` again.

success.title: Login successful
success.body: You're logged in — return to your terminal. pmon will finish automatically. You can close this tab.

scopes.title: This login asks for more than reading and querying
scopes.intro: Approve only if you asked for these. Besides reading and running queries, an agent using this login can:

names.mcp_approvals_write: Approve, reject, and run query approvals and access requests as you
names.mcp_datasources_write: Create, change, and delete datasources and column classifications
names.mcp_identity_write: Manage users, groups, and role assignments
names.mcp_policies_write: Create, change, and delete policies, roles, and mask functions
names.mcp_tokens: Mint and revoke your access tokens

scopes.unknown: Use a permission this page does not describe
scopes.windowHours: These extra permissions last {hours, plural, one {for # hour} other {for # hours}} after you approve. Reading and querying last for the whole login.
scopes.windowMinutes: These extra permissions last {minutes, plural, one {for # minute} other {for # minutes}} after you approve. Reading and querying last for the whole login.
